canonical_project: DataVolt Karakalpakstan AI Data Center (500 MW proposal)
notes: Trade press (DCD, 2025-05) reported DataVolt plans a ~500 MW AI data center in Karakalpakstan powered by renewables (~USD 3bn). Trade-press planned lead; no official decree, land allocation or named site verified in this pass. Note: 500 MW figure overlaps with DataVolt's country-program total (up to 500 MW by 2032 across TAS-1/New Tashkent/Bukhara) - treat as Karakalpakstan-specific proposal only if official sources confirm.
